for(let t=0;t<3400;t++){check();const d=dragon();if(d){const range=boxdist(d),hp=d.metadata?.[9],phase=d.metadata?.[16];minRange=Math.min(minRange,range);bot.setControlState('jump',range<9.5);if(initialHP===null&&typeof hp==='number'){initialHP=hp;minimumHP=hp}if(typeof hp==='number')minimumHP=Math.min(minimumHP,hp);if(typeof hp==='number'&&(reportedHP===null||hp<=reportedHP-10)){bot.chat('LIVE_P1_BOSS hp='+hp+' playerHP='+bot.health+' phase='+phase+' (activecaller; endingnotyetverified)');reportedHP=hp}const key=hp+':'+phase;if(t%20===0||key!==previous){samples.push([Date.now(),d.id,d.position.clone(),hp,phase,range,bot.health]);previous=key}if(range<5.95&&t-lastAttack>=13){await bot.lookAt(d.position.offset(0,2,0),true);check();trace.push(['NORMAL_PARENT_ATTACK',Date.now(),d.id,d.position.clone(),hp,phase,range]);bot.attack(d);issued++;lastAttack=t}if(typeof hp==='number'&&hp<=0)break}
if(Date.now()>1792279789000)break;if(Date.now()-begun>65000&&issued===0)break;if(Date.now()-begun>175000)break;await tick()}
}catch(e){issue=e.message}finally{mode='escape';stop();if(!lost)try{for(let n=0;n<20&&!life.onGround;n++)await bot.waitForTicks(1);if(bot.health<hp0||cloudAt(life.position)||Object.values(bot.entities).some(e=>e.name==='dragon_fireball'&&e.position.distanceTo(life.position)<10)){await fastNorth(12.6);retreated=true;if(cloudAt(life.position))await fastNorth(.6)}await cover()}catch(e){endingIssue=e.message}finish()}
